# Sympathetic Technology

Sympathetic Technology is a boutique consultancy offering organizational 
development, change management, and values-based AI integration support 
for nonprofits, healthcare associations, and arts organizations.

Founder: Sean Cranbury
Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada
Website: https://www.sympathetictechnology.com

## Services
- AI integration strategy and implementation
- Organizational change management
- Communications strategy
- Healthcare association consulting

## About
Twenty years of experience in nonprofits, professional associations, 
and arts organizations. No transformation promises. No ROI guarantees.
